## 2024-05-14 - Optimized AnalyzedContent Component
**Learning:** Found that string tokenization logic (`text.split` with a capturing group) placed matched terms exactly at odd indices, meaning an expensive array `.some()` check (O(N)) could be entirely replaced with a simple parity check (O(1)).
**Action:** When working with tokenized string arrays generated by regular expressions with capturing groups, leverage index parity for identification instead of re-evaluating matches on each array element. Also applied React.memo and useMemo for further caching.
